identity.title: Adaptive Polygon eth_getLogs Response-Bound Chunking Repair
identity.objective: Preserve the certified 4 MiB Polygon RPC response cap and 100-block runtime lookback while allowing an oversized multi-block eth_getLogs range to complete through deterministic left-first bisection into smaller bounded ranges, with single-block oversize remaining terminal and no provider, credential, trading, live, dependency or workflow authority change. Triggered by S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01 Phase B follow-up 15 on the deployed b815eed release: host proof passed through the isolated window, then the one canonical smoke failed with RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE and zero Polygon raw rows while the other public HTTP and WebSocket surfaces stored rows. Not a C8G capacity failure. Phase B stays suspended.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01R3. An oversized eth_getLogs range again becomes a terminal RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE receipt with no subdivision; the regression tests and repair status/spec artifacts disappear. The response cap, lookback default, max block span, provider and method allowlists, R2 transport, store, runtime, runner, deployment tooling, dependencies and workflows are untouched; no host, store, order or capital state is touched.

api_matrix.reason: Private eth_getLogs chunk collection behavior only; no public function signature, CLI, limit, store or receipt field changes.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules close the adaptive eth_getLogs range bisection, its terminal and non-split cases, the shared-state/checkpoint/budget invariants and the unchanged bounds and authority.

items.required_rule: An eth_getLogs range [A, B] with A < B whose response exceeds max_response_bytes (RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE) is bisected at mid = floor((A + B) / 2) into [A, mid] and [mid + 1, B]; the left child completes before the right; recursion happens only when a child is itself RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE; no gap or overlap; no random, time-dependent or estimated sizing.
items.validation_rule: Offline behavioral tests of the exact eth_getLogs request sequence and raw cursors for one split, a nested split and a cap+1 response.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: A single-block range whose response exceeds max_response_bytes returns FAILED RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE and is never re-requested; a response of exactly max_response_bytes follows the unchanged normal path.
items.validation_rule: Offline behavioral tests with exact-cap and cap+1 padded responses.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: NETWORK_TIMEOUT, RESPONSE_INVALID (non-2xx or invalid JSON), CHAIN_ID_MISMATCH and every other error remain terminal and never trigger subdivision or a retry of the identical request; no provider fallback.
items.validation_rule: Offline behavioral tests asserting the single eth_getLogs request per failing range.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: Every child uses the same rate-limited rpc closure and shared max_network_calls budget, store, limits, latest_block, parent received_at and seen_log_ids; budget exhaustion keeps STOPPED / NETWORK_CALL_LIMIT; a child failure keeps earlier append-only evidence, returns the truthful failure and never advances the chain checkpoint.
items.validation_rule: Spy on the recursive chunk calls, a duplicate-log test, a child-failure checkpoint test and real RateLimiter budget tests through the runtime RPC pass.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: max_response_bytes stays 4,194,304, onchain_lookback_blocks stays 100 (runtime config and CLI default), max_block_span stays 2,000, confirmation depth stays 64, the provider allowlist stays drpc only and the method allowlist stays eth_chainId, eth_blockNumber, eth_getLogs, eth_getBlockByNumber.
items.validation_rule: Offline constants test and provider/method authority test with a transport-call counter.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: No VPS mutation, diagnostic, smoke, mixed window, backup, restore or reboot; no credential, account, signing, order, capital, live, workflow, dependency, store, runtime, runner or deployment-tooling change; no real network call in tests; Phase B stays suspended until merge and fresh authorization.
items.validation_rule: Exact five-path diff; authority mirror; socket guard in tests; status entry.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code
